# Clinical notes summariser

*Client industry: healthcare | Completed: 2022-05-10 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p03*

## The problem
The client was doctors spending evenings on discharge summaries.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an open model, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project reduced summary writing time by about half in a 3-week pilot.
